title: VPFlow: Value-Predictive Planning with Imperfect World Models for Offline Goal Reaching
abstract: arXiv:2610.27280v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Offline goal-conditioned reinforcement learning enables skill acquisition by reaching any goal from any state without dense rewards. Model-based methods allow for planning by scaling test-time compute to solve complex tasks. Combining both holds appealing promise for pre-training on suboptimal demonstrations and zero-shot adaptation via goal specification and planning. Yet existing methods assume effective planning requires accurate next-state prediction in pixel or latent space. In this work, we show that value prediction is more useful for planning, whereas accurate state prediction is often unnecessary. Our key insight is that offline goal reaching naturally admits a closed-form Monte Carlo return, enabling value regression to replace temporal-difference bootstrapping. translated_title: VPFlow：基于不完美世界模型的价值预测规划实现离线目标达成
translated_abstract: 离线目标条件强化学习使智能体无需稠密奖励即可通过从任意状态到达任意目标来习得技能；基于模型的方法则可以通过扩展测试时计算来进行规划，从而解决复杂任务。将二者结合，对于在次优演示数据上进行预训练，并通过指定目标和规划实现零样本适应，具有诱人的前景。然而，现有方法假设有效规划需要在像素空间或潜在空间中对下一状态进行准确预测。在这项工作中，我们证明价值预测对规划更为有用，而准确的状态预测往往是不必要的。我们的关键洞察是：离线目标达成天然地存在闭式蒙特卡洛回报，使价值回归能够取代时序差分自举。我们将该回报作为潜在世界模型的唯一监督信号：想象出的潜在状态被训练来预测目标达成价值，而非匹配未来状态……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出VPFlow，其核心创新在于证明离线目标达成中的规划依赖的是价值预测而非准确的状态预测，并利用闭式蒙特卡洛回报直接回归目标达成价值来监督潜在世界模型，从而在无需精确世界模型的情况下实现高效规划。
en_tdlr: VPFlow shows that planning in offline goal reaching benefits from value prediction rather than accurate state prediction, using closed-form Monte Carlo returns as the sole supervision so that latent world models predict goal-reaching value instead of matching future states.
